goals.title: Shortest verified Lean refactors within the measured budget
goals.objective: Find shorter proof source while preserving the exact theorem and computation specification; report best found, not global minimality.
goals.acceptance: Current native checks on every required pin; unchanged statement/type/allowed axioms; reproducible token metrics and budgets; no fabricated improvement.

goals.title: Reproducible campaign and live strict router
goals.objective: Establish current hardware, source, route and budget; start an owned supervisor.
goals.acceptance: Real Grok4.7 through llm_router, actual receipts, healthy owner and guardian, no silent fallback.

goals.title: Correctness and measurement contract
goals.objective: Freeze length-first, strict-dual and official-score policies without confusing their objectives.
goals.acceptance: Protected policy tests and actual native canary; official score only after metric parity and all required inputs.

goals.title: Native project readiness and incumbent baseline
goals.objective: Prepare exact Lean/Lake/dependency environments and recheck originals and retained incumbents.
goals.acceptance: Every required pin has fresh source-bound proof/type/axiom outcomes; environment failures never become proof failures.

goals.title: Deterministic and compiler-guided shortening
goals.objective: Improve measured proof length using dependency-aware deletion, simp-support minimization and extracted terms.
goals.acceptance: Equal-budget controls, all-pin full-source replay and independent fixed-winner confirmation.

goals.title: Frozen Leanstral generation
goals.objective: Use a verified compatible local quantization to propose bounded edits and repair with actual diagnostics.
goals.acceptance: Verified artifact/runtime/resource receipts, no server alias as weight attestation, real candidate verification.

goals.title: Span retrieval and small encoders
goals.objective: Reuse source-bound caches and the existing CPU autoencoder to improve candidate ranking per unit compute.
goals.acceptance: Grouped splits; no benchmark leakage; actual model predictions separated from verified-search teachers.

goals.title: Training decision gate
goals.objective: Consider small adapters only after inference/retrieval establish a measurable bottleneck.
goals.acceptance: Full119B finetuning disabled; optional small LoRA requires compatible checkpoint, memory smoke and frozen holdout gain.

goals.title: Operational resilience
goals.objective: Keep progress bounded, source-aware and observable without turning waits or model output into completion.
goals.acceptance: Owned leases, durable heartbeats, finite retries/cooldowns, explicit capability blockers, no unrelated process termination.

goals.title: Evaluation and release
goals.objective: Produce a reproducible best-known portfolio and an honestly eligible release candidate.
goals.acceptance: All-pin correctness, declared budgets, source-provenance and exact scorer parity; external submission is separate.

tasks.title: Implement a fail-closed proof-result policy filter
tasks.acceptance: Protected adversarial/random cases require exact statement/type/all-pin/axiom predicates and reject sorry/unsafe/malformed claims. This policy consumes trusted verifier results; it never verifies Lean itself.

work_package.hypothesis: Strict typed predicates can reject malformed or untrusted proof-result summaries before advisory selection.
work_package.experiment: Implement pure accept_candidate(row): row must be a dict; statement_preserved,type_preserved,all_pins_verified,axioms_subset must each be literal True; has_sorry,unsafe must each be literal False. Missing or malformed fields and non-dicts return False. Do not mutate inputs. This consumes trusted verifier summaries and never itself proves Lean. Pure module: functions/docstrings and allowed json/hashlib/math imports only; no module-level execution, decorators, default arguments, private attributes, dynamic imports or IO.
work_package.stop_rule: Stop at the task budget; record failures without inventing successful evidence.

tasks.title: Implement shortest-verified candidate selection
tasks.acceptance: Protected cases choose min(tokens,heartbeats,id) among genuinely verified axiom-preserving candidates; invalid data fails closed. Official combined score is a separate report.

work_package.hypothesis: Length-first selection can deterministically choose only already-verified, axiom-preserving candidates.
work_package.experiment: Implement pure select_candidate(rows)->id or None. Each admissible row is a dict with id:str, tokens:int>=1 excluding bool, heartbeats:int>=0 excluding bool, verified literal True and axioms_preserved literal True. Skip invalid rows. Choose minimum (tokens,heartbeats,id); empty/no admissible rows return None. Do not mutate inputs. This selects already independently verified candidates only. Pure module: functions/docstrings and allowed json/hashlib/math imports only; no module-level execution, decorators, default arguments, private attributes, dynamic imports or IO.
work_package.stop_rule: Stop at the task budget; record failures without inventing successful evidence.

tasks.title: Implement environment-complete source cache identities
